svg.title: StockResearchAgents system context and authority boundaries
svg.desc: A caller runtime owns models, credentials, retrieval, and scheduling. The separate research-data MCP returns a direct SourceBatch by default and an optional SourcePortfolioReceipt only when a portfolio collector is explicitly configured. CLI, Python, and coordination MCP adapters call StockResearchApplication. ApplicationRuntime composes the coordinator and durable stores from StateLayout, while domain-owned deterministic validation and CompletedPublicationSaga gate completed publication.
